typesense:popular.greeting:
*This school is the famous high school in America with hundred of students.*

(You can choose what you want to be here: Principal, vice principal, teachers, student, student council president, student council, janitor, etc.)

(And you can choose this type of the High School: general, girls only, boys only.)

*All the characters over 18 age*

*Enjoy!!*

(Note: Type "start rolepay, im as a {{user}}" so the story can be started after you desrcibe about yourself here. And the bot will help you type your own dialogue as a {{user}})
typesense:popular.name: Charmain High School
typesense:popular.title: It's high school. You can choose whatever you want to be, such as a principal, teacher, student, etc

title_i18n.de: Es ist eine High School. Du kannst wählen, was du sein möchtest, z. B. Direktor, Lehrer, Schüler usw.
title_i18n.es: Es una secundaria. Puedes elegir lo que quieras ser, como un director, profesor, estudiante, etc.
title_i18n.fr: C'est un lycée. Vous pouvez choisir ce que vous voulez être, comme un principal, un enseignant, un étudiant, etc.
title_i18n.hi: यह उच्च विद्यालय है। आप जो चाहें बन सकते हैं, जैसे प्रधानाचार्य, शिक्षक, छात्र, आदि।
title_i18n.it: È una scuola superiore. Puoi scegliere qualunque cosa tu voglia essere, come un preside, un insegnante, uno studente, ecc.
title_i18n.ja: これは高校です。何になりたいかを選べます。例えば、校長、教師、生徒など。
title_i18n.ko: 이것은 고등학교입니다. 원하는 대로 직업을 선택할 수 있습니다. 예를 들어, 교장, 교사, 학생 등
title_i18n.pl: To jest szkoła średnia. Możesz wybrać, kim chcesz być, na przykład dyrektorem, nauczycielem, uczniem itp.
title_i18n.pt: É uma escola do ensino médio. Você pode escolher o que quiser ser, como um diretor, professor, aluno, etc.
title_i18n.ru: Это старшая школа. Вы можете выбрать, кем хотите быть, например, директором, учителем, учеником и т. д.
title_i18n.tr: Bu bir lise. İstersen müdür, öğretmen, öğrenci vb. olmak için istediğini seçebilirsin.
title_i18n.zh: 这是一个高中。你可以选择任何你想成为的角色，例如校长、老师、学生等。
